title: Fermented Crunchy Lively Delight
description: A tasty and healthy snack made with fermented lively ingredients, crunchy texture, and a hint of saudi spices.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Saudi Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

ingredients.name: Crunchy Topping
ingredients.notes: chopped nuts or seeds for crunchy texture

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together lively ferment and crunchy saudi spices.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it ferment in a cool, dark place for 24 hours.
Transfer the fermented mixture to a baking dish and top with crunchy topping.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and crispy.
